svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Container diagram for an online store subtitle: "C4 model, level 2: the containers inside the system, and the people and external systems around it" direction: down # One port per edge, so the web and back office calls into the API each keep their own arrowhead. layout: { spacing: normal, merge: false } legend: solid: "Relationship [technology]" groups: store: { type: c4:boundary, label: "Online store [Software System]" } # C4-PlantUML colors: person #08427b, container #438dd5, external system #999999. nodes: customer: { shape: person, label: Customer, note: "[Person]
Browses and buys products", color: "#08427b" } staff: { shape: person, label: Support staff, note: "[Person]
Handles orders and refunds", color: "#08427b" } web: { shape: box, label: Web application, note: "[Container: React]
Lets customers browse and check out", color: "#438dd5", in: store } admin: { shape: box, label: Back office, note: "[Container: React]
Lets staff manage orders and refunds", color: "#438dd5", in: store } api: { shape: box, label: API application, note: "[Container: Go]
Serves catalog, cart and checkout", color: "#438dd5", in: store } # The database beside the API it serves keeps the boundary to two rows. db: { shape: cylinder, label: Database, note: "[Container: PostgreSQL]
Stores products and orders", color: "#438dd5", in: store, align: api } # The email service first, so it sits on the customer's side and its receipts line runs straight up. email: { shape: box, label: Email service, note: "[Software System]
Delivers order receipts", color: "#999999" } payments: { shape: box, label: Payment provider, note: "[Software System]
Takes card payments and refunds", color: "#999999" } edges: - customer -> web: Browses and buys products using [HTTPS] - staff -> admin: Manages orders using [HTTPS] - web, admin -> api: "Makes API calls to [JSON/HTTPS]" - api -> db: Reads and writes [SQL] - api -> payments: Charges cards and issues refunds [HTTPS] - api -> email: Sends e-mail using [SMTP] # Written in layout order (the customer above the email service) with the arrow flipped, so the people stay on top. - { from: customer, to: email, arrow: start, label: "Sends receipts to [SMTP]" }

svg.title: Container diagram for an online store
svg.desc: Container diagram for an online store. 8 components in 1 groups. Connections: Customer to Web application (Browses and buys products using [HTTPS]); Support staff to Back office (Manages orders using [HTTPS]); Web application to API application (Makes API calls to [JSON/HTTPS]); Back office to API application (Makes API calls to [JSON/HTTPS]); API application to Database (Reads and writes [SQL]); API application to Payment provider (Charges cards and issues refunds [HTTPS]); API application to Email service (Sends e-mail using [SMTP]); Customer to Email service (Sends receipts to [SMTP]).

text.tspan: CONTAINER DIAGRAM FOR AN ONLINE STORE
C4 model, level 2: the containers inside the system, and the people and external systems around it
